time-converter.extraDst: DST: nonexistent wall times are rejected; repeated times use the earlier instant. ISO offsets take precedence over the selected zone.
time-converter.extraExplicit: The selected unit is always used; units are never guessed.
time-converter.extraInputHint: Use YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or ISO 8601 with seconds and optional milliseconds and offset.
time-converter.milliseconds_hint: Enter a whole number in the selected unit.

curl-converter.extraInvalidEditor: Check the URL, method, headers, query keys and JSON body. Invalid input clears generated code.
curl-converter.extraSaved: Template saved on this device; sensitive request content was omitted.
curl-converter.extraStorageError: Browser storage is unavailable or full.
curl-converter.extraBodyHint: GET and HEAD bodies are omitted. JSON mode validates syntax; add a Content-Type header when needed.
curl-converter.extraRemote: Code generation runs locally. Sending uses this server’s proxy to contact public HTTP(S) targets; the backend blocks private targets.
curl-converter.extraSanitized: Only method and origin are saved after an explicit save. Paths, query parameters, headers and body are omitted to avoid storing credentials. Refill them after loading. Up to 10 templates stay in this browser.
curl-converter.extraTiming: Elapsed time including proxy round trip

json-generator.extraLimits: Limits: 1–1000 records, 1–50 unique fields, length 0–1000, estimated content ≤2 MB. Dates span 2020–2030. Boundary mode alternates numeric/date/boolean endpoints; text keeps the exact length.
json-generator.extraInvalid: Check unique field names, integer bounds, lengths, record count and null probability, or reduce the output size.
